sentences.text: The Retail Loan Policy allows the bank, at reset of a floating-rate loan, to offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate, as per its Board-approved policy.
That matches the current RBI rule for UCBs, which permits a UCB at the time of reset of interest rates to provide a choice to switch over to a fixed rate as per its Board-approved policy.
The earlier RBI circular on reset of floating interest rate on EMI-based personal loans is no longer in force as of 2026-11-23.
